final_message:
`wolfi` and `chainguard` no longer crash on ids like `GO-2026-5932`. For those ids, `build_reference_links` now returns only the distro security page link. CVE and GHSA ids get the same links as before.

The cause was `SecDBParser.build_reference_links` in `src/vunnel/providers/wolfi/parser.py`. It passed the result of `vulnerability.build_reference_links` straight to `urls.extend`, and that function returns `None` for ids that aren't `CVE-` or `GHSA-` prefixed. I changed it to `or []`.

I checked it by calling the method with a stub parser: `build_reference_links("GO-2026-5932")` returned `['u/GO-2026-5932']` (where `u` is the stub's `security_reference_url`). I didn't add a regression test.

15 tests fail, all in `tests/quality/test_configure.py`, and the same 15 fail without my change. The ones I looked at hit a missing `yardstick` module, and I didn't check each of the 15. I had to run pytest with `PYTHONPATH=src` because the `.venv` can't import `vunnel` otherwise.

`answer.json` is written in the repository root with the one-sentence summary.

steps.command: sed -n 55,85p src/vunnel/providers/secureos/parser.py; sed -n 55,85p src/vunnel/providers/wolfi/parser.py; grep -n "def build_reference_links" -A25 src/vunnel/utils/vulnerability.py; grep -rn "build_reference_links" src/vunnel/providers/minimos

sed -i 's/^        urls.extend(vulnerability.build_reference_links(vulnerability_id))/        urls.extend(vulnerability.build_reference_links(vulnerability_id) or [])/' src/vunnel/providers/wolfi/parser.py
echo '{"summary": "SecDBParser.build_reference_links now tolerates ids without CVE-/GHSA- prefixes, falling back to the distro security page link."}' > answer.json
.venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -3; git diff --stat

PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | grep FAILED | grep -vc yardstick; PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -c "
from vunnel.providers.wolfi.parser import Parser as P
print(P.build_reference_links(type('X',(),{'security_reference_url':'u'})(),'GO-2026-5932'))"

PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | grep FAILED | grep -v yardstick | cut -c1-200 | head -3; git stash -q; PYTHONPATH=src .venv/bin/python -m pytest -q 2>&1 | tail -1; git stash pop -q
